description.zh:
集群ID。
> 您可以通过[DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~)接口查看账号下所有集群的详细信息，包括集群ID。
description.en:
The cluster ID.

> For more information, see [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~).

description.zh:
删除脱敏加密规则。取值范围如下：

v1：删除脱敏规则。
v2：删除加密规则。
description.en:
The type of rule to delete. Valid values:

v1: deletes data masking rules.
v2: deletes data encryption rules.

description.zh:
需要删除的脱敏规则名称。支持输入多个规则名称进行批量删除，多个名称间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
> 您可以通过[DescribeMaskingRules](~~212573~~)接口查看目标集群下所有脱敏规则的详情，包括规则名称。
description.en:
The names of the data masking rules to delete. To delete multiple rules in a batch, separate the names with commas (,).

> For more information, see [DescribeMaskingRules](~~212573~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb delete-masking-rules --rule-name-list testrule --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000000 --interface-version v1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb DeleteMaskingRules --region cn-hangzhou --InterfaceVersion v1 --RuleNameList testrule --DBClusterId 'pc-00000000000000000'
